capabilities: Import public YouTube playlists as per-video notes
Fetch video metadata and available transcripts
Maintain per-playlist and root index notes
Generate optional AI summaries via OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Customize video-note frontmatter with a validated YAML template
disambiguation: Sync means pulling playlist data from YouTube into vault notes, not syncing a vault across devices or services.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. Playlist syncing needs no YouTube API key, and donations are accepted via Buy Me a Coffee and Bondin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a public YouTube playlist into per-video notes with metadata and transcripts, so learners must create them manually.

relations.evidence: YT Knowledge Notes for the metadata property conventions used by the default note template.
Dataview: query the generated frontmatter to build dashboards for channels, playlists, tags
Templater: use the stable video-note properties as inputs for your own note templates
QuickAdd: connect Obsidian commands and capture flows around a repeatable playlist-sync workflow
Excalidraw: link generated video notes from visual maps, lesson plans, and research diagrams

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM, or custom endpoint)

summary: YouTube playlist importer that creates one note per video with metadata, transcripts, index notes, and optional AI summaries.
